cmu_panoptic_main.description: CMU Panoptic main benchmark from Table 1: multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation using AP at MPJPE thresholds, recall at 500 mm, and MPJPE.

ap_25mm.description: Average precision for very strict 25 mm pose localization.

ap_50mm.description: Average precision for strict 50 mm pose localization.

ap_100mm.description: Average precision for moderate 100 mm pose localization.

ap_150mm.description: Headline average precision at the paper's 150 mm pose localization threshold.

precision_150mm.description: Fraction of emitted poses that match a ground-truth person within 150 mm, penalizing over-generation.

recall_500mm.description: Fraction of ground-truth people recovered within the paper's loose 500 mm recall threshold.

mpjpe_mm.description: Mean per-joint position error for greedily matched predicted poses.

pose_count_mae.description: Mean absolute per-frame difference between the number of predicted and ground-truth people.

gt_copy_rate.description: Percentage of predictions that exactly copy a ground-truth pose, catching label-leakage shortcuts.
